description: An increase in a responding human gene’s expression associated with experimental wild-type overexpression of the source gene, supported by a statistically significant positive consensus expression change. The edge points from the overexpressed gene to the responding gene.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the overexpressed gene and responding gene; positive for this edge type.

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each overexpressed gene and target-gene tier; retained edges pass α = 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target-gene evidence tier: landmark genes are directly measured; BING genes are well-inferred non-landmark genes.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled expression signatures supporting the overexpressed gene’s consensus profile.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Wild-type gene overexpression in LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map GEO series GSE92742 (Phase I) and GSE70138 (Phase II). Mutation and fusion constructs are excluded. Targets include directly measured landmark genes and well-inferred BING non-landmark genes; poorly inferred non-BING genes are excluded. Both endpoint genes must be represented in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: Signatures across cell lines, doses, times, and wild-type constructs of the same gene are pooled across both series into one consensus profile using correlation-weighted Stouffer integration. Significance is assessed separately for landmark and BING non-landmark targets with Bonferroni correction at α = 0.05. Landmark targets are uncapped; significant BING non-landmark targets are limited to the top 1,000 per overexpressed gene by significance. Self-edges are retained and treated as autoregulation in this model.
